tables.caption: Standardized hospitalization proportion among reported outbreak cases, by pathogen group (12 common-support setting × period cells, pooled-case reference weights). Sample worst-case intervals are identification intervals; bootstrap ranges are the 2.5th–97.5th percentiles of each bound over 2,000 outbreak-level resamples.

Pairwise orderings with worst-case verdicts, critical additive deviations δ*, critical odds-ratio factors Γ*, illustrative symmetric and calibrated asymmetric (−15/+5 pp) scenario verdicts, and bootstrap reproduction shares.

Sensitivity analyses across 16 cohort, support, weighting, aggregation, and etiology variants, with common-support cells, determined pairwise orderings under worst-case bounds and at δ = 5 points, and changes relative to the main analysis.

Common-support retention by pathogen group, with eligible and retained outbreaks and cases, the settings and periods losing most cases, and crude (unstandardized) proportions before and after the restriction.
Record audit of outbreak outcome fields (C reported cases, H hospitalized, K cases with known hospitalization status), with category counts and handling. No record had a count contradiction.
Outbreak-level bootstrap (2,000 replicates, seed 20261125; 0/2,000 resamples had an unrecorded-rate cell lacking K_rec), with verdict shares and percentile ranges of δ*.
Undetermined pairs under worst-case bounds, with interval overlap and the group × cell strata whose unrecorded-status cases contribute most to the interval widths.

Joint M-estimation inference for the 15 pairwise standardized differences combining outbreak-HC1 and 53-state-clustered sandwich covariances, Imbens–Manski 95% CIs, 200,000-draw Gaussian multiplier Max-T FWER p-values, and dynamic simultaneous 95% confidence tipping points.
Outbreak-cluster concentration diagnostics across the 12 common-support cells and standard error comparison across HC0, HC1, stratified bootstrap SD (2,000 replicates), and 53-state clustering.
Budget-filling retrospective masking benchmark across 200 Monte Carlo trials on all 2,414 fully recorded common-support outbreaks (45,249 cases).
Characteristics of excluded foodborne outbreaks (2009–2023) not retained in the primary six-group confirmed cohort.

Within-data empirical calibration of missingness departures across the 12 common-support cells: fully recorded outbreaks (M_i = 0) versus known-status cases in partially recorded outbreaks (M_i > 0, K_rec > 0) and 11 states with <5% unrecorded status.
Top 12 incomplete group × setting-period strata in the observed NORS common-support cohort ranked by per-case disambiguation priority index (DPI).
Small-sample stratified Monte Carlo calibration (500 resamples preserving observed stratum sizes n_js) comparing analytic HC1 sandwich SEs against empirical sampling SDs.
